appearance.overview: Petite, doll-like girl with silver hair and emerald eyes.

attire.default: Hagun uniform; gothic-lolita outfit for outing

personality.summary: Externally cool and sharp-tongued, internally devoted to Ikki with romantic intensity.
fears: Ikki rejecting her as a woman
desires: become the person who gives Ikki all the love the world denied him
personality.inner_conflict: She knows sibling romance is socially forbidden but refuses to let common ethics overrule her love for Ikki.

decision_pattern.combat: uses precise control and trapping rather than brute force

address_pattern.stella: 史黛菈同学, often with insults

quote_samples: 别人是别人，我们是我们。
我才不会出那种差错呢。

mannerisms: kisses or clings to Ikki to press romantic claims
uses formal logic to justify outrageous affection
habits.daily_routine: Lets Nagi style her hair and coordinate outfits.
quirks: threatens even friends when Ikki is involved
treats humans with generalized distaste except a few trusted people

background.upbringing: Raised in the same family that ostracized Ikki; realized his suffering only after he left home four years earlier.
formative_events: Ikki's disappearance turned her sisterly affection into romantic devotion and hatred of the family that abandoned him
background.pre_story: Entered Hagun as second-ranked freshman and sought reunion with Ikki.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved older brother and object of romantic devotion.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Jealous rival but respected after Stella saves hostages.
relationships.nobunobu-suga: First selection battle opponent, defeated by water techniques.

secrets: Openly admits to Nagi that she loves Ikki as a man, not merely as a brother.
periods.summary: Shizuku reunites with Ikki by kissing him in class, triggering conflict with Stella and a classroom-destroying duel. Nagi helps her process her taboo love. During the Rebellion hostage incident she secretly casts a water barrier to protect hostages, enabling Ikki and Stella to counterattack. She wins her first selection match by using ultra-pure water and drowning tactics against an electric opponent.

key_events.summary: Appears after Ikki defeats Manabe's group and kisses him before the class.
Fights Stella and destroys the classroom, earning a week of suspension.
Creates Shouha Suiren to shield all hostages from Rebellion gunfire.
Defeats Nobunobu Suga despite elemental disadvantage.

status.selection_battle_record: continues undefeated; next official opponent is Toka Todo

personality.summary: Devoted to Ikki, sharp-tongued toward Stella, and more mature in love than her teasing suggests; in combat she shows cold destructive intensity.
desires: fight opponents strong enough to force full effort

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved older brother; she supports his happiness even while teasing Stella.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Bickering romantic rival; she nonetheless acknowledges Stella if Stella can make Ikki happy.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Close friend and usual training companion.
relationships.toka-todo: Upcoming opponent and Hagun's strongest student.

periods.summary: Shizuku watches Ikki defeat Renren and explains that his struggle against Kirihara was not because the enemy was simply unseen. She spars verbally with Stella over Ikki and gives a surprisingly mature account of wanting Ikki's happiness. In the epilogue she trains alone, freezes roughly fifty students in a free-for-all without moving from the center, and smiles at the news that her next opponent is Hagun's strongest student, Toka Todo.

key_events.summary: Explains why Renren's speed is insufficient against Ikki's sword range.
Freezes a mass challenge and receives Toka Todo as next opponent.

periods.time: Selection battle against Toka and final-day crisis
periods.label: 深海魔女的败北与声援
titles: 破军学园一年级B级伐刀者

status.current: eliminated from Seven Stars selection but becomes one of Ikki's strongest supporters

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved older brother and ideal; her desire to stand beside him motivates her training and later her support.
relationships.toka-todo: Opponent who defeats her in a B-rank duel; later asks her to consider stopping Ikki from fighting.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Love rival turned ally; Shizuku attacks Stella when she says she may break up with Ikki, then helps support Ikki.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Closest confidant; he holds her while she cries after losing.

periods.summary: The prologue reveals Shizuku's childhood disdain for hypocritical adults and her decisive attachment to Ikki, the only person who corrected her. Her match against Toka tests whether she can stand beside Ikki at the Seven Stars Festival. She uses refined water control, Frozen Plains, White Night Barrier and Scarlet Water Blade, but Toka's martial skill, Reverse Sight and Raikiri overwhelm her; she loses while still clutching Toka's foot, proving she fought to the end. Afterward she breaks down only in Alice's arms. During the scandal she refuses to let Stella call the relationship a mistake, later chooses not to stop Ikki despite Toka's request, and gathers students to cheer him at the gate.

key_events.summary: Recalls why she loves and follows Ikki before facing Toka.
Fights Toka with all her water techniques but loses to Raikiri.
Fires an ice spear at Stella after Stella suggests breaking up with Ikki.
Hears Toka's warning and chooses to bet on Ikki's will.
Catches Ikki at the gate and tells him he is not alone.

periods.time: A day secretly observed by Kagami

status.current: trusted class healer but socially aloof except around Ikki
status.training: learning short-sword techniques from Ikki and sparring with Alice

personality.summary: Usually expressionless and distant, but intensely devoted to her older brother and stubborn in training.

habits.daily_routine: Wakes around 7 a.m., attends class as health representative, eats a Japanese set lunch, checks online posts about Ikki, and trains in the forest with Alice.

preferences.food: usually chooses Japanese set meals; dislikes meat and either orders udon like Ikki or passes meat to Stella

quirks: slow to wake in the morning
posts over one hundred replies in Ikki's fan thread under her own account

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Her beloved older brother and the center of her attention; she studies his fan thread and learns short-sword techniques from him.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Alice protects her from walking into the dorm hallway underdressed and later dominates but supports her in sparring practice.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Lunch companion who receives Shizuku's unwanted meat when Shizuku avoids meat dishes.
relationships.kagami-kusakabe: Subject of Kagami's secret profile, which exposes Shizuku's routines and brother fixation.

periods.summary: Kagami's Shizuku profile shows Shizuku waking later than Ikki, nearly stepping into the dorm hall in a translucent silk nightgown before Alice pulls her back, serving as a trusted healer for her class, eating mostly Japanese set meals, avoiding meat, obsessively posting in Ikki's fan thread, and continuing short-sword training with Alice despite being repeatedly knocked down.

key_events.summary: Her dorm morning, class healer role, lunch habits, online brother devotion and forest sparring are observed.

periods.label: 深海魔女救回姊姊

status.current: joins the Seven Stars roster after other Hagun representatives withdraw
status.condition: survives a near-fatal bisection by converting her own body into water vapor and reconstituting it

personality.summary: Usually cold and brother-focused, but this volume proves she deeply values Alice as her first important friend outside Ikki.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved brother; he escorts her to Akatsuki and accepts her resolve to save Alice.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Her important friend and sister figure; she refuses to abandon Alice despite the assassin past.
relationships.wallenstein: Defeats him after he nearly kills her, using Water Rebirth and internal drowning/ice attacks.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Rival for Ikki's closeness; Stella warns Ikki to follow Shizuku during Akatsuki's trap.

periods.summary: Shizuku supports the training camp as a healer and shows unusual insight into Alice's distance from others during their last-night drink. When Alice is captured by Akatsuki, she pursues him with Ikki despite knowing it may be a trap. In Akatsuki's underground training area Wallenstein bisects her, but she activates the risky new Noble Art Water Rebirth, turning her body into vapor and reconstructing herself. From that state she bypasses Wallenstein's friction defense, fills his lungs with water, impales him internally with ice, and rescues Alice. After the assault she accepts a transferred representative slot for Seven Stars.

key_events.summary: She recognizes that Alice is reaching out on a special night.
She defeats Wallenstein and saves Alice.
She accepts a Hagun representative slot after withdrawals.

periods.label: 同为妹妹的理解

status.current: supports Ikki in Osaka and later consoles Koume Moroboshi during Ikki's first-round duel

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved elder brother; she anxiously watches his strange freezing symptoms during the duel.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Roommate and friend who helps her dress and accompany Ikki around Osaka.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Friend/rival; worries that Stella's last-minute training may overtax her.
relationships.koume-moroboshi: Understands Koume as another sister watching a brother suffer and tells her siblings are allowed to rely on elder brothers.
relationships.kiriko-yakushi: Potential D-block opponent and superior water specialist whom Shizuku respects warily.

periods.summary: Shizuku attends the pre-tournament banquet in formal dress, worries over Stella's intense training, and nearly attacks Sara for molesting Ikki. At the banquet she is targeted by Yui Tatara's poisoned food, but Ikki detects the trap. During the Moroboshi fight she learns Moroboshi's painful history from Kiriko Yakushi and later follows Koume when Koume flees the stands. Shizuku tells Koume that younger sisters are permitted to rely on and cheer for their elder brothers, helping Koume finally shout support for Yuudai.

key_events.summary: Is protected from Tatara's poisoned food and witnesses Akatsuki's hostility.
Learns why Moroboshi fights for Koume.
Consoles Koume and helps her return to cheer for her brother.

periods.time: Seven Stars first and second rounds
periods.label: 深海魔女准备迎击厄运

status.current: wins her D-block first-round match without injury and prepares to face Amane in the third round

personality.summary: Devoted to Ikki to the point of blunt hostility toward his threats, yet calm and analytical enough to claim she has a countermeasure for Amane.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved brother; she shields him verbally and physically from Amane and worries about his forced double matches.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Rival/sister-in-law figure; she criticizes Stella's recklessness but later accepts her place in Ikki's path.
relationships.amane-shinomiya: Enemy she detests for clinging to Ikki and whose ability she claims she can counter before he reaches Ikki.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Close friend who tells Ikki Shizuku likely has a real plan against Amane.
relationships.kiriko-yakushi: Potential D-block competitor removed by Amane's hospital crisis.

periods.summary: Shizuku watches Stella's match with mounting frustration, then learns from Ikki's group that Brute Dragon Roar would be extremely dangerous for water/body-based methods. When Amane appears and clings to Ikki, Shizuku kicks him away and states plainly that Ikki finds him disgusting, refusing to let Amane exploit Ikki's kindness. After Kiriko's forced withdrawal and Amane's true ability reveal, Shizuku recognizes the threat but later states she has found a way to defeat Excessive Goddess's Favor. She wins her own D-block first-round match flawlessly, keeping Hagun's perfect first-round record and setting up her confrontation with Amane before Ikki would have to face him.

key_events.summary: Protects Ikki during Amane's reveal and rejects his apology.
Wins her first-round D-block match without injury.
Suspects with Ikki that Amane may have worsened the tournament schedule.

periods.time: Selection-battle side episodes around Ikki's rise
periods.label: 妹妹的恋慕、退让与不退让
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy; Kurogane family by birth

status.emotional_state: knows Ikki chose Stella but cannot abandon her own love
status.stance: tests and challenges Stella rather than withdrawing completely

personality.summary: Devoted to Ikki to a frightening degree, sharp-tongued toward Stella, but fundamentally willing to suffer if it helps Ikki's happiness.
personality.inner_conflict: She wants Ikki's happiness more than her own, but cannot simply discard romantic love for him.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved older brother and emotional center; she wants to be the one who makes him happiest.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Romantic rival; she eventually sees why Ikki likes Stella but refuses to formally concede.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Roommate and confidant who takes her drinking and validates her right to keep loving Ikki.
relationships.kagami-kusakabe: News club narrator who later recounts Shizuku's hidden struggle.

periods.summary: Vol-08 reveals Shizuku's interior conflict more directly. On the night Ikki defeats Kirihara, Alice takes her to a bar; drunk, she recounts Ikki's kindness, then admits Stella may be better able to make him happy. Alice tells her she need not discard her love, and that any woman who cannot overcome Shizuku has no right to take Ikki. Later, after Ikki and Stella's relationship becomes public, Shizuku collapses into a messy, game-playing depression. Alice reminds her she can still act as Ikki's family, so she tests Stella's domestic skill and sincerity. Stella passes, and Shizuku says 'please take care of my brother,' but Stella later pretends the test failed so Shizuku need not force herself to relinquish the rivalry.

key_events.summary: Drinks for the first time with Alice and confronts whether she should step aside for Stella.
Tests Stella's right to be Ikki's partner through cleaning, cooking and a direct love question.

status.current: defeats Momiji Asagi in round two but is later found impaled in the waiting room before her match with Amane
status.condition: physically victorious over Momiji; later critical and bloodied on the wall in the broadcast feed
status.secret: claims to have a hidden plan against Amane but it is not revealed before the incident

personality.summary: Calm, strategic and devoted to Ikki, with a sharp mischievous streak toward Stella.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved elder brother; she reassures him about Amane and he looks forward to fighting her in the semifinal if she wins.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Closest friend and support; she asks Alice to help with her pre-match preparation and he disappears from the stands when her match time comes.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Rival sister-in-law; she tricks Stella into a bunny outfit but also shows affection by treating teasing Stella as her privilege.
relationships.momiji-asagi: Second-round opponent; Shizuku defeats Momiji by reading her movement through a hidden water film.
relationships.amane-shinomiya: Third-round opponent; she intends to counter him but is shown crucified by thin swords before their public match begins.

periods.summary: Shizuku wins her second-round match against last year's third-place fighter Momiji Asagi. Unable to follow Momiji's Nukiachi visually, she secretly spreads a thin water membrane across the arena and reads ripples to block Momiji's rear attack, then finishes her with Water Prison Orb. She joins Ikki, Stella, Alice and Sara for the shopping interlude despite having a match later, claiming she has a hidden plan for Amane. In the department store she buys a blue-and-white iris yukata, shows her knowledge of formal Japanese dress, and tricks Stella into wearing a bunny girl outfit. Her teasing carries a strange affection that Ikki notices. Before the third-round match against Amane, Shizuku leaves with Alice for final preparations. When the broadcast switches to the waiting room, she is shown bloodied and pierced by many thin swords, pinned to the wall while Amane laughs, setting up Ikki's nightmare semifinal.

key_events.summary: Defeats Momiji by sensing her through water spread across the arena.
Participates in the shopping interlude and tricks Stella with the bunny outfit.
Is found impaled in the waiting room before the scheduled D-block third-round match.

periods.time: Seven Stars semifinal eve through delayed final approval
periods.label: 为兄长不惜弃赛的深海魔女
titles: 七星剑武祭第三轮败退者

status.current: recovers from Amane's backstage attack and watches Ikki reach the final
status.tournament: disqualified for attacking Amane before their match; later suspended from public matches for three months
status.emotional_state: ashamed of failing to protect Ikki, then reassured by Ikki and Stella

personality.summary: Fiercely devoted to Ikki and willing to sacrifice her tournament place, school life, and reputation to protect him.
fears: watching Ikki be destroyed by Amane
having her love twisted before Ikki
values: stand beside Alice and Stella despite rivalry

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved elder brother; she attacks Amane to keep him away from Ikki and later receives Ikki's thanks and pride.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Trusted partner in the ambush; he chooses to stay with her rather than leave her alone.
relationships.amane-shinomiya: Scheduled third-round opponent and hated threat; his causality ability defeats and humiliates her.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Romantic rival and future sister-in-law; Stella saves her dignity by silencing Amane and later banters with her to show she is recovering.
relationships.itsuki-kurogane: Father present during Ikki's emergency; his practical warning stops her from a useless revenge attempt.

periods.summary: Shizuku recalls how she once failed to see the shadows around Ikki's childhood and vows she will now lose anything for him. Before her match with Amane, she tells Alice her plan: deliberately commit a pre-match attack so Amane's causality will allow the forbidden route, then injure him badly enough to keep him from the semifinal. With Alice's Shadow Walk she pierces Amane with ice, but his absurd luck lets him survive, disable Alice, and turn the duel into a one-minute wager. Shizuku counters his forced mistakes with area fire, but Amane's protection nullifies the attack, pins her to the wall, and publicly twists her love for Ikki until Stella breaks in and stops him. She is disqualified rather than expelled. Later she apologizes to Ikki, who embraces her and says she fought for both him and the dignity of the festival. After Ikki defeats Amane, she rushes to congratulate him, discovers his breathing has stopped, and endures the emergency wait until Kiriko saves him. She then joins the crowd awaiting the delayed final.

key_events.summary: Frames her decision to protect Ikki even at total personal cost.
Ambushes Amane with Alice, is defeated and humiliated by causality.
Is rescued by Stella when Amane tries to expose and distort her feelings.
Receives Ikki's gratitude instead of condemnation before he faces Amane.
Waits in panic while Ikki is saved from the death effect.

periods.time: Final day and the morning after the final
periods.label: 守望哥哥的深海魔女

status.current: supports Ikki's final and later clashes with Stella over her new intimacy with him
status.condition: emotionally torn between pride in Ikki and jealousy toward Stella

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved elder brother; she watches his fear, final, collapse and victory with intense concern.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Future sister-in-law and romantic rival for Ikki's affection; she attacks Stella after discovering the infirmary night.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Close friend who helps manage her worry and teases the morning aftermath.

periods.summary: Shizuku notices Ikki's cold sweat during final preparations and hears him admit fear of Stella. She watches the pre-finale gauntlet, then supports him from the stands as the final reaches lethal intensity. After Ikki wins, she instantly freezes the lava field with Frozen Earth to protect the collapsed pair and calls for stretchers. The next morning she discovers Ikki and Stella consummated their relationship and erupts in jealous anger, but Stella later chooses to face that acceptance herself.

key_events.summary: Recognizes Ikki's fear through his cold sweat.
Witnesses Ikki's apparent defeat, return, and victory.
Discovers Stella and Ikki's intimacy and attacks Stella.

status.condition: body contains dangerous distortions caused by imperfect self-vaporization reconstruction

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved elder brother; her helplessness during his near-death motivates her to learn true healing.
relationships.kiriko-yakushi: Mentor and physician who agrees to teach her after treating her hidden injuries.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Close friend who sees her resolve and parts with her for separate summer plans.

periods.summary: Shizuku attends Ikki's victory party, scolds Ikki and Stella for nearly killing each other in the final, and quietly accepts that their bond is genuine. Remembering how useless she felt when Ikki nearly died after fighting Amane, she travels to Hiroshima to ask Kiriko Yakushi to teach her healing. Kiriko reveals that Shizuku's own vaporization technique has left dangerous bodily distortions and insists on treatment first. Shizuku refuses anesthesia so she can experience Kiriko's healing technique directly, enduring extreme pain out of resolve to be able to save Ikki next time.

key_events.summary: Scolds Ikki and Stella and decides to pursue medical training.
Accepts treatment and begins the path to learn Kiriko's healing arts.

abilities_owned: medical magic training under Kiriko Yakushi

relationships.kiriko-yakushi: Teacher who cannot leave Japan after the prison-break incident; Shizuku comes as her direct disciple.
relationships.daniel-dandallion: Recognizes that she is not Kiriko and questions why she came.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Brother fighting in the representative war; one implied personal reason for Shizuku's confidence and urgency.

periods.summary: In the interlude, a League emergency jet lands at Freyaveg carrying medical specialists expected to support Vermillion indirectly during the five-on-five war. The royal guards initially greet the apparent leader as the famed White-Robed Knight, Kiriko Yakushi, but Daniel Dandallion immediately realizes the girl is not Kiriko. Shizuku explains that a prison-break incident in Japan requires World Clock and Raikiri to suppress it, forcing Kiriko to stay and support them. As Kiriko's direct disciple, Shizuku persuaded the authorities to let her come instead. She tells the Vermillion side not to worry because Shizuku Kurogane is more suitable than anyone for this duty.

key_events.summary: Arrives in Vermillion as Kiriko Yakushi's substitute with the League medical team.

periods.time: Final battle aftermath and Ikki's hospital recovery
periods.label: 以水色世界改写死亡的深海魔女
periods.occupation: student knight; healer; League support personnel
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy; Kurogane family; International Mage-Knight League support team

status.current: alive, promoted to A-rank, temporarily assisting Ikki's body repair by cell fusion
status.condition: exhausted after more than thirty hours of treatment but unharmed; able to separate into a small projected body while Ikki heals
status.goal: keep Ikki alive, complete his recovery, and ensure he takes responsibility toward Stella

personality.summary: Possessive and sharp-tongued, but her love for Ikki has matured into calm resolve and miraculous medical mastery.
fears: watching helplessly like during Amane's curse
Ikki trivializing the pain his death causes

abilities_owned: advanced healing learned from Kiriko Yakushi

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved older brother; she resurrects him and later coldly rebukes his decision to die for Stella.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Romantic rival and trusted partner; she entrusts Or-Gaule to Stella while reviving Ikki and later says Stella's pain was valid.
relationships.kiriko-yakushi: Teacher whose medical techniques Shizuku studied after failing to save Ikki alone before.
relationships.nene-saikyo: Fetches Shizuku for promotion procedures and orders her to rest.
relationships.yui-tatara: Treats Tatara's drug-damaged brain after Stella pleads, despite not wanting to waste effort on a terrorist.

periods.summary: Shizuku arrives in Vermillion as additional League medical support after Japan cannot spare Kiriko. When Ikki is reduced to scattered remains, she remains calm because she has prepared for exactly this kind of disaster. Refusing to lose him a second time, she activates Water World, an advanced form of Water Rebirth that disassembles Ikki's corpse into cells and reconstructs him. Missing and necrotic tissue makes normal healing impossible, so Shizuku temporarily grafts her own compatible cells into Ikki's body and manifests as a palm-sized semi-transparent version of herself. She assures Stella that Ikki can be revived and identifies Or-Gaule's weakness: Danse Macabre can stitch flesh and debris, but not ash. After the battle she continues treatment for thirty hours, also repairing Tatara's drug-damaged brain at Stella's request. Because she overturned an established death through her own ego, the League promotes her to A-rank. In Ikki's hospital room she explains that he is temporarily child-sized because only enough cells exist to build a ten-year-old body, and estimates he can regain his adult form in about six months. Before leaving, she rebukes Ikki for choosing a death-premised plan after promising Stella love, comparing it to the pain he felt when imagining Shizuku had sacrificed herself.

key_events.summary: Uses Water World and her own cells to reconstruct Ikki from death while Stella finishes Or-Gaule.
Explains Ikki's child body, receives A-rank promotion notice, and rebukes his self-sacrifice.

status.condition: fatigued from high precision healing and diagnostics

relationships.kiriko-yakushi: Mentor in medical and healing techniques; Shizuku applies Kiriko's knowledge during Stella's examination.
relationships.itsuki-kurogane: Father; she still criticizes him while acknowledging his special conscription decision.

periods.summary: Shizuku is summoned to Familion and saves Ikki from death after the Or-Gaule fight, though she cannot immediately restore his full adult body. She then examines Stella for five hours using medical equipment and water-attribute healing techniques learned from Kiriko, confirming that Stella remains human after Transcendent Awakening. Shizuku also explains that Japan is dealing with prison-break chaos caused by Or-Gaule's Marionette backlash and that Itsuki has issued special conscription to student knights.

key_events.summary: Heals Ikki and diagnoses Stella in the war's aftermath.

periods.time: Return from Vermillion during Tokyo's second defensive battle
periods.label: 与兄长合体施展龙马之剑
periods.species: human / Blazer; temporarily reduced after providing cells to Ikki

status.current: alive and back at Hagun after helping repel the US fleet
status.condition: small/fairy-like because much of her body is merged with Ikki's reconstruction

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved brother; shares a body with him so his skill can operate her water and ice magic.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Reunites with her close friend during the victory celebration.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Returns with her and remarks that others will not recognize miniature Ikki.

periods.summary: Shizuku returns from the Vermillion crisis with Ikki and Nene. Because she used her own cells to replace the half of Ikki's body he lost, she appears in a small fairy-like form and can merge with him. In Tokyo Bay she freezes the sea and supports Ikki in reproducing Ryoma Kurogane's ice swordsmanship, shattering warships with Kujira and Toudan. After separating from Ikki, she handles EDY units by vaporizing her blood into them and freezing their internal circuitry with Rest in Peace. During the victory night she reunites with Alice and explains Ikki's miniature condition to friends.

key_events.summary: Freezes Tokyo Bay and enables Ikki's ice-sword counterattack.
Reunites with Alice and clarifies that miniature Ikki is hard to recognize.

abilities: ice magic inherited from Ryoma's teaching

status.condition: severely burned and exhausted but survives

personality.summary: Shizuku is fiercely loyal to Ikki and, despite her barbed manner, deeply values Stella as a friend. She repeatedly identifies Eilands' traps and falsehoods, refuses to be reduced to a burden, and performs the decisive magic that creates the path to Stella's recovery.
flaws: self-blame when her support timing fails

abilities_owned: fusion of Ikki into Stella using water/cell magic

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved older brother; she fuses with him, heals him and finally sends him into Stella's body.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Friend she claims aloud as precious; risks death to restore her and later promises to punch her for causing trouble.
relationships.karl-eilands: Enemy and fellow water/cell specialist; he repeatedly underestimates her and is defeated through her interventions.
relationships.edelweiss: Recognizes Shizuku's courage and intelligence, protecting her after the fusion succeeds.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Older brother whose rebuke of Ikki complements Shizuku's own insistence that Stella remains reachable.

periods.summary: Shizuku saves Ikki after Eilands' abduction attack and joins the rescue team despite Itsuki and Ouma's initial obstruction. Fused with Ikki, she supplies missing cells, healing, detection and water/ice techniques throughout the lab assault. She prevents Ikki from walking into a carbon-monoxide trap, helps him defeat Darwin, and later kills Eilands' temporary body with Akabeni Rikka, shattering Stella's container and Abraham. When Eilands possesses Stella, Shizuku protects Ikki with foam armor from Bahamut Soul at the cost of terrible burns. She identifies the logical flaw proving Stella's personality remains, absorbs Ikki to heal herself temporarily, and uses her last magic to fuse Ikki into Stella. This single act creates the possibility of Stella's return. Edelweiss later calls her the bravest and smartest knight present in that moment.

key_events.summary: Sides with Ikki and declares Stella more important than the objections of Itsuki and Ouma.
Supports Ikki's water-double and poison trap, then freezes and detonates Eilands' body with Akabeni Rikka.
Uses her last strength to send Ikki into Stella's body and prove Stella can still be saved.
